blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Shareholders of AREIT Inc. have approved a P17.33-billion property-for-share swap with sponsor Ayala Land Inc. (ALI) and its subsidiaries, paving the way for six malls and hotels to be added to the real estate investment trust’s portfolio.
